info.title: Civgraph API
info.description: Read-only. Routes, parameters and answer shapes change only compatibly (additions) within a version; an incompatible change is a new version, and this one keeps answering. Fields not named in a schema may appear; ignore the ones you do not know.

get.description: The answer of /_api/elections, which stays as an alias. Variants: record (view=record); manifest (view=manifest); summary (view=summary); provenance (view=provenance); areas (view=areas); list (view=list); detail (view=detail); contests (view=contests); citations-person (view=citations, person=…); citations-contest (view=citations, constituency=…); citations-contest-by-name (view=citations, constituencyName=…); citations (view=citations); index-of-body (no key, body=…); index (no key); contest-by-slug (key=…, contest=…); contest-by-name (key=…, constituencyName=…); contest (key=…, constituency=…); bundle (key=…, format=bundle); election (key=…).

anyOf.title: record (view=record)
anyOf.description: One Browse election record: an election's detail item or a contest's

anyOf.title: manifest (view=manifest)
anyOf.description: Every election the map app can show

anyOf.title: summary (view=summary)
anyOf.description: One election's summary

anyOf.title: provenance (view=provenance)
anyOf.description: Where each contest's figures came from

anyOf.title: areas (view=areas)
anyOf.description: A national contest's results by area (the presidential elections by Dáil constituency): per area, each candidate's figure at every count, the candidates named by their one national candidacy; areas is empty when the election has none

anyOf.title: list (view=list)
anyOf.description: The Browse list of elections, or a page of it

anyOf.title: detail (view=detail)
anyOf.description: One election's Browse detail

anyOf.title: contests (view=contests)
anyOf.description: One election's contests as Browse items

anyOf.title: citations-person (view=citations, person=…)
anyOf.description: The original sources of every contest a person stood in

anyOf.title: citations-contest (view=citations, constituency=…)
anyOf.description: One contest's original sources (key null: no such election)

anyOf.title: citations-contest-by-name (view=citations, constituencyName=…)
anyOf.description: One contest's original sources, the contest found by its name

anyOf.title: citations (view=citations)
anyOf.description: An election's distinct original sources, with how many of its contests cite each (key null: no such election)

anyOf.title: index-of-body (no key, body=…)
anyOf.description: One body's elections, by date then key

anyOf.title: index (no key)
anyOf.description: Every election, by date then key

anyOf.title: contest-by-slug (key=…, contest=…)
anyOf.description: One contest found by its Browse slug: candidates and counts

anyOf.title: contest-by-name (key=…, constituencyName=…)
anyOf.description: One contest found by its name

anyOf.title: contest (key=…, constituency=…)
anyOf.description: One contest by its sequence number

anyOf.title: bundle (key=…, format=bundle)
anyOf.description: The election bundle (the static file's shape); lite=1 leaves out the counts

anyOf.title: election (key=…)
anyOf.description: One election with its constituencies

301.description: A renamed record: Location gives its current address under this version

5XX.description: The data store is unavailable or failed
